o.norm: tests that the pretty printer does not collapse (trim leading | trailing whitespace) when there are sequential textnodes. That doesn't happen in a parse, but can when manipulated. needs to be text that would indent

i.norm: Tests that the pretty printer preserves whitespace between sequential text nodes that were created by DOM manipulation (not parsing), specifically that leading and trailing whitespace is not collapsed when multiple TextNodes are siblings.
Parsing produces a single TextNode, but after calling .after() we get two sequential TextNode siblings: "Hello" and " there." The pretty printer must not trim the leading space of the second node.
Verify the two sibling TextNodes were created with the expected raw text
Verify the combined text and HTML rendering are correct
